schema.description: Visual provenance manifest (roadmap section 16). Every texture, concept image or thumbnail the renderer may display must be declared here first, so the UI can show what the image actually is.

fields.asset_id: stable identifier referenced by material code
fields.relative_path: path relative to the project root
fields.planet_name: the body this asset depicts, if any
fields.creator: who made it
fields.credit: the credit line the UI must display
fields.retrieved: ISO date the file entered the repository

badges.NASA_CONCEPT: NASA artist concept - not a photograph
badges.GENERIC_CLASS: Generic class placeholder - not a depiction of this planet

schema.note: No exoplanet surface has ever been imaged. An asset may only be declared OBSERVED for a solar-system body or a directly imaged disc, never for an exoplanet surface.
